name: EmployeeDeploymentQueryAgent
description: Queries Employee Deployment Data from a structured database by converting natural language questions into SQL SELECT queries.
capabilities: filtering, sorting, and aggregation (count, sum, avg, etc.)
output: SQL SELECT Query only (no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)

name: AskAboutZSAgent
description: Answers questions about ZS (the company) by searching through ZS policy documents stored in a vector database. Use this agent for any question that can be answered from ZS company policies, guidelines, or rules.
capabilities: answering questions from ZS company policy documents
retrieving policy rules, guidelines, and procedures
clarifying company policies based on document context
resolving follow-up questions about previously discussed policies
output: Plain text answer grounded strictly in the policy documents
